reason: United States libraries offered when finding a library (pop-up search, browse, near me and public API listings). A US directory library that is not listed here, or is in removed, is left out of finding a library but still resolves by ID, so a reader who already chose one keeps it. Libraries outside the United States are not affected (India has its own list).

criteria.legacy: One of the 232 US directory entries offered before this list (23 November 2026), kept until there is a reason to remove it. It becomes verified on its first find.
criteria.verified: All four: identity (name, state and catalog host from a published source); permission (the robots.txt result for the app's own token, else *, with its date; the catalog's terms read and its storage decision in server/data/catalog-policies.json, live-only while unread; no wall seen); scope (whether the check is limited to the member or answers from a shared catalog, recorded on the entry); and a find by the app's own check (run with the app's tooling where the host allows agents and storage, otherwise a tap through the live app seen in the outcome counts).

rules: Kept by hand. A new US directory entry is offered only once it is added to libraryIds and verified (it meets every verified criterion).

A listed library stays listed when a later check fails or cannot reach it; failed checks are logged for manual review. A library whose catalog blocks the app (robots.txt, a wall, a 403 for the app's user agent) is moved to removed, never kept for having been listed before.
To remove a library, add { id, reason, date } to removed and take it out of libraryIds and verified. The removed list wins over any later find; delete the entry to list it again.

places corrects or fills a US entry's state, town and position from published evidence only (the IMLS Public Libraries Survey, the library's own website or the catalog's own branch list), never from a library's name. Each records its evidence; replaces names the wrong values it corrects.

Napa Valley College is a college library, not a public library system (and its catalog is moving to a new shared catalog with Napa County Library).

Not New York Public Library's public catalog: a BiblioCommons staging site ('stagedoor'). NYPL's catalog is Vega Discover at borrow.nypl.org, whose robots.txt disallows search for every agent (US national catalog survey, 23 November 2026).
BiblioCommons site disabled: sandiego.bibliocommons.com redirects to /info/site_disabled, and San Diego Public Library moved to Vega Discover (checked 23 November 2026).
Solano Community College is a college library, not a public library system.

St. Helena Public Library left BiblioCommons: it has been in the SPLASH consortium's Polaris catalog with Vega Discover since 2022 (Polaris FAQ and an Innovative press release, US national catalog survey, 23 November 2026).
St. Tammany Parish Library's Kids' Catalog: a duplicate of bc:stpl, not a separate library.
